scientific_question: Under declared conditional independence and theta-invariant proxy marginal, does true expected-CRPS interaction equal tr(F_A S_B), and does centered Gaussian CDF integration agree with the candidate kernel?
reference_claim_to_falsify: S_hk=(1-sqrt(1-rho_h*rho_k))/sqrt(pi); mixed Gaussian common standard-normal target/proxy margins

continuous_gaussian_panel.independent_energy_integral: Adaptive integral of 2*x*NormalDensity(x; variance=(rho_h-rho_k)^2+sigma_h^2+sigma_k^2), x=0..infinity; no closed E|N| formula used.
continuous_gaussian_panel.tail_bound: For centered entries outside +/-L, Cauchy-Schwarz and total variance bound absolute tail by 2*phi(L); no material assumptions.

independent_methods: Exact Fraction joint-table enumeration of Bayes expected CRPS risks for all observations
Centered conditional CDF B/z product quadrature with fixed two levels
Independent absolute-value energy density quadrature from shared latent B and independent residual coefficients

tolerances.finite_discrete: exact Fraction equality, zero numerical tolerance

execution_policy.on_failure: Preserve FAILURE and partial outputs; report root. No increasing tolerance, adding nodes, changing fixtures or silently rerunning. Any defect fix requires new explicit source/plan/approval.

interpretation: Classic finite Bayesian/CDF information identity and controlled falsification only; no novelty, empirical efficacy or actual acquisition-cost superiority assertion.
